name: Banu in the West
source:
Banu has a messy past—she’s cheated before but wants to change. She spends a month in the West while her husband battles illness. Players guide her through temptations, cultural clashes, and difficult choices.

[From [url=https://iskender77.itch.io/banu-in-the-west]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
巴努有着一段混乱的过去——她曾经被骗过，但她想改变。当她的丈夫与病魔作斗争时，她在西方度过了一个月。玩家引导她应对诱惑、文化冲突和艰难的选择。

[来自[url=https://iskender77.itch.io/banu-in-the-west]Itch.io[/url]]
